headline: Approved the prior meeting's minutes and welcomed three participants; discussed the Annual Appeal, annual meeting, and November event.
summary: Talk covered the November Lyceum event, the annual meeting theme and merchandise, and the Annual Appeal. The Appeal kicks off November 1 with a direct mailing the first week of November. Suggestions for new Corporators are due by the end of October.

plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
Gloucester Lyceum & Sawyer Free Library 
Corporate Communications Committee  
Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 9:00 AM 
As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, this Committee will continue to hold meetings 
remotely. Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below. 
Via Zoom only: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86018488672  
To join by phone:  646-931-3860  
 
Attendance: In person: Fran Aliberte (Chair), Christine Araujo, Christine Armstrong, Dawn 
Sarrouf, Library Director Jenny Benedict, and guests Geoff Bradford and Julia Brotherton 
Via video conference: Jason Brisbois, Cheryl Marks, Katy Marques 
 
Not Present: n/a 
 
 
1. Call to order  
 
2. Welcome + Introductions 
a. Dawn moved to welcome Jason, Cheryl, and Katy to the meeting. Christine 
seconded and the motion was approved. 
 
3. Approval of Minutes from September 15, 2026. The minutes, as presented, were 
approved via roll call. 
 
4. Library Programming Update 
a. Jenny shared highlights of upcoming programs.  
 
5. Tech Event - Jenny 
a. Final plans being put into place this week. Jenny thanked Board members who 
loaned technology for the event. 
 
6. November Lyceum Event - Julia  
a. Julia shared an update on the event. She and Christine will meet after the 
meeting to discuss promoting the event and setting up online registrations. The 
Committee is meeting on Thursday to conduct a site visit. 
b. The working group is meeting with moderator Jon Keller next to strategize for 
taking questions.  
 
7. Annual Meeting - Christine 
a. Theme: Public access, shared ideas, stronger communities, banned books. 
b. Annual Appeal materials will be available. 
c. Merchandise: There was discussion of having branded items for sale: t-shirts, 
mugs, tote bags.
Page 2 of 2 
 
8. Corporators 
a. Please provide suggestions for new Corporators to Christine and Fran by the end 
of October. 
 
9. Annual Appeal - Christine 
a. Kick off on November 1st. There will be a direct mailing the first week in 
November. 
b. We should talk up this being the first full year in the new building. 
 
10. Development Committee - Geoff 
a. This working group will start brainstorming about approaches for appealing to 
potential donors, e.g., early childhood development, youth programs, digital 
equity, community space and programs, local history center.  
 
11. Other - When there are news items that relate to the Library and might generate 
questions from the public to Trustees Geoff will send a heads-up email to Trustees. 
 
12. Next meeting: Tuesday November 10, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. – 10:00 a.m. 
 
13. 9:55 Adjourn. There being no further business the meeting was adjourned. 
 
Respectfully submitted, Tracy Bowen
